## Vegan NMDS - Weekly comparisons by deployment

### Load in datasets
```{r load data}

# read in full distance matrix and metadata
dissim_og <- read_csv("data/Df_analysis/Dissim_tables/dissim_matrix_dep_month_diel.csv")

# load HMD weekly data -- has deployment ID and ISO week info
all_dep_psd <- read_csv("data/Df_analysis/All_deps_monthly_diel_PSD.csv")

# get grouping info from original PSD data
all_dep_labels <- all_dep_psd |>
  select(network, npz_id, Dep_ID, month_UTC,light_reg) |>
  mutate(Dep_ID = str_replace(Dep_ID, "PARKSAUSTRALIA_","")) |>
  filter(# only keep MMP and SWC from Southwest network
         npz_id != "Jurien" & npz_id != "Geographe" & npz_id != "Two Rocks") |>
    # distinct combinations
  distinct() |>
  # create label that will match pivoted data to enable filtering
  mutate(dep = paste(Dep_ID, month_UTC, light_reg, sep = "_"))


months_to_use <- all_dep_labels |>
  group_by(network, month_UTC) |>
  summarise(n_deps_mo = n()) |> 
  filter(n_deps_mo >= 1)



dissim_all <- dissim_og |>
  left_join(all_dep_labels, by = "dep") |>
  filter(!is.na(Dep_ID)) |>
  # join with subset of months common to multiple deployments
  left_join(months_to_use) |>
  # filter out remaining weeks
  filter(!is.na(n_deps_mo)) 


```

```{r filter data}
  select(dep, all_of(dep_light_all))

# get rid of deployment column to make square matrix, format as distance matrix
dissim_dist_all = as.dist(dissim_all |>
                        select(-dep))

  select(dep, contains("CGMP") | contains("SIMP")) |>
```

### NMDS 

```{r NMDS}

# set start point for reproducibility
set.seed(2025) 

# calculate nmds ordination from vegan package
nmds_all <- metaMDS(dissim_dist_all, k=2,  autotransform = FALSE, plot = FALSE)

nmds_stress <- nmds_all$stress

# get nmds scores as data frame
nmdsScores_all <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_all)) |>
  # add deployment-months (rownames) as separate column
  rownames_to_column(var = "dep") |>
  # join to label info
  left_join(all_dep_labels) |>
  mutate(week_fac = factor(month_UTC),
         light_fac = factor(light_reg))


# explore initial patterns in ordination

ggplot(data = nmdsScores_all,
       aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)
       )+ 
  theme_bw()+
  geom_point(aes(color = npz_id,
    shape = light_fac), 
           size = 4,
       alpha = 0.5)+
   stat_ellipse(aes(group = npz_id,
                    color = npz_id),
               data = nmdsScores_all,
               size = 1,level = .95) + #95% CI ellipse (assumed multivariate normal)
  geom_text(aes(label = month_UTC,
                color = npz_id),
            vjust = -1,
            hjust = 1.0)+
  labs(caption = paste0("stress = ", nmds_all$stress))
# 
# ggsave(paste0("figs/", "NMDS_month_diel_all_npz_color.png"), width=12, height=8,
#        units="in", dpi=300)
```



### Look into presence data

```{r adding presence}

hp_month_prop <- read_csv("data/All_sites_tables/allsources_by_month_diel.csv") 

# add weekly pres to NMDS scores
monthly_pres_data <- nmdsScores_all |>
  # left join with nmds to subset to common weeks and force same order
  left_join(hp_month_prop, by = c("Dep_ID", "month_UTC", "light_reg")) |>
  mutate(month_fac = as_factor(month_UTC))
  

  ## Evaluate correlation between ordination and environmental data
  env_test <- envfit(nmds_all, 
                     monthly_pres_data |>
                       # only keep grouping columns and presence columns
                       select(npz_id, network, month_UTC, light_reg, all_of(ends_with("_pres"))), 
                     permutations = 999, 
                     na.rm = TRUE)
env_test


env_pvals_vec <- env_test$vectors$pvals |>
  enframe()

env_pvals_fac <- env_test$factors$pvals |>
  enframe()


envScores <- as_tibble(scores(env_test, "vectors"), rownames = "name") |>
  left_join(env_pvals_vec) |>
  rename("Variable" = "name", 
         "pval" = "value")


# scale vector lengths to NMDS scores rather than "unit" length
# have to use base plots to get scaling to work
plot(nmds_all)
plot(env_test)

scaled_env_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(env_test, 
                                          display = "vectors",
                                          arrow.mul = ordiArrowMul(env_test))) |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "name") |>
  left_join(env_pvals_vec) |>
  rename("Variable" = "name", 
         "pval" = "value")

# pull out sig scores only
sig_scaled_scores <- scaled_env_scores |>
  filter(pval <= 0.05)

envCent_network = as.data.frame(scores(env_test, 
                                       display = "factors",
                            arrow.mul = ordiArrowMul(env_test))) |>
  rownames_to_column(var = "cent_label") |>
  filter(grepl("network",cent_label))

envCent_npz = as.data.frame(scores(env_test, , 
                                       display = "factors",
                            arrow.mul = ordiArrowMul(env_test))) |>
  rownames_to_column(var = "cent_label") |>
  filter(grepl("npz_id",cent_label)) |>
  mutate(cent_label = str_replace(cent_label, "npz_id", ""))

# plot vectors onto NMDS


ggplot(data = nmdsScores_all,
       aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)
       )+ 
  theme_bw()+
  geom_point(aes(color = npz_id,
           shape = light_reg), 
           size = 4,
       alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_segment(data =scaled_env_scores,
               aes(x=0,
                   xend=NMDS1,
                   y=0,
                   yend=NMDS2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")),
               colour="black",
               alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_text(data = scaled_env_scores,
            aes(x = NMDS1,
                y = NMDS2,
                label = Variable),
            alpha = 0.5)+
   geom_segment(data =sig_scaled_scores,
               aes(x=0,
                   xend=NMDS1,
                   y=0,
                   yend=NMDS2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")),
               colour="black",
               size = 1.5)+
  geom_text(data = sig_scaled_scores,
            aes(x = NMDS1,
                y = NMDS2,
                label = Variable))+
  # add network centroids from envfit
  geom_point(data = envCent_network,
             aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2),
             size = 3)+
  geom_text(data=envCent_network,
            aes(x=NMDS1,
                y=NMDS2,
                label=cent_label),
  size=4)+
  geom_text(data=envCent_npz,
            aes(x=NMDS1,
                y=NMDS2,
                label=cent_label),
  size=4)+
  # add network ellipses from NMDS
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = network),
               data = nmdsScores_all,
               size = 1,level = .95) + #95% CI ellipse (assumed multivariate normal)
   stat_ellipse(aes(group = npz_id),
               data = nmdsScores_all,
               linetype = "dotted",
               size = 1,level = .95) +
  labs(caption = paste0("stress = ", nmds_stress, "\n sig. vectors (p<0.05) in bold"))
# 

# ggsave(paste0("figs/", "NMDS_month_all_presence_vectors.png"), width=12, height=8,
#        units="in", dpi=300)

```

# clustering

```{r cluster}
sdf_agnes = agnes(dissim_dist_all, diss = T, method = "ward")

# Visually assess the tree
plot(sdf_agnes,which.plots = 2)
summary(sdf_agnes)

# k = 5 seems reasonable based on looking at dendrogram
# use clusterboot() from fpc package to test stability of clusters if k=5

agnes_boot <- clusterboot(dissim_dist_all, 
            clustermethod = hclustCBI, 
            method = "ward.D2",
            k = 5,
            seed = 32165)

# From "Practical Data Science With R" book, Ch 8:
# "As a rule of thumb, clusters with a
# stability value less than 0.6 should be considered unstable. Values between 0.6 and 0.75
# indicate that the cluster is measuring a pattern in the data, but there isn’t high certainty about which points should be clustered together. Clusters with stability values
# above about 0.85 can be considered highly stable (they’re likely to be real clusters)."
agnes_boot$bootmean
# [1] 0.7291170 0.6791824 0.9870130 0.9371382 0.7320519
agnes_boot$bootbrd
# [1] 20 34  1  2 30

# Suggests cluster 1 (CGMP), 2 (DMP), and 5 (SIMP) are less stable than 3 (MMP) and 4 (SWCMP/NMP)
# -- all are still above 'rule of thumb' 0.6 cutoff



sdf_agnes_cut <- cutree(sdf_agnes, k = 5)
nmdsScores_all$cluster = factor(sdf_agnes_cut)

# format cluster model for ggplot
dendr <- dendro_data(sdf_agnes)
dendr[["labels"]] <- merge(dendr[["labels"]], nmdsScores_all, by.x="label", by.y = "dep")


# plot clusters
ggplot() + 
  geom_segment(data=segment(dendr), 
               aes(x=x, 
                   y=y, 
                   xend=xend,
                   yend=yend)) + 
  geom_text(data=ggdendro::label(dendr), 
            aes(x, y, label=label, hjust=0.5, color=cluster),
            angle = 90, size = 3)+
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.1, end = 0.8)
# ggsave(paste0("figs/", "AGNES_all_month_diel_clusters_k5.png"), width=12, height=12,
#        units="in", dpi=300)

# plot NMDS with clusters

ggplot(data = nmdsScores_all,
       aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)
       )+ 
  theme_bw()+
  geom_point(data = nmdsScores_all, aes(color = cluster,
           shape = light_fac), 
           size = 4,
       alpha = 0.5) +
  # geom_text(data = nmdsScores_all, aes(label = npz_id),
  #           vjust = -1, 
  #           hjust = 1.0)+
  # geom_segment(data =envScores,
  #              aes(x=0,
  #                  xend=NMDS1,
  #                  y=0,
  #                  yend=NMDS2),
  #              arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")),
  #              colour="black")+
  # add npz centroids from envfit
  # geom_point(data = envCent_npz,
  #            aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2),
  #            size = 3)+
  # geom_text(data=envCent_npz,
  #           aes(x=NMDS1,
  #               y=NMDS2,
  #               label=cent_label),
  #           size=4)+
  # add cluster ellipses
  stat_ellipse(data = nmdsScores_all,
               aes(color = cluster),
               # linetype = "dotted",
               size = 1,
               level = 0.95)+
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.1, end = 0.8)+
    labs(caption = paste0("stress = ", round(nmds_all$stress, digits =4)))

# ggsave(paste0("figs/", "NMDS_month_diel_all_dissim_clusters.png"), width=12, height=8,
#        units="in", dpi=300)
# 
#
```

```{r psd plots by cluster}

# join cluster ID to weekly PSDs

psd_monthdiel_cluster <- all_dep_psd |>
  mutate(dep = paste0(Dep_ID, "_", month_UTC,"_",light_reg),
         dep = str_replace(dep, "PARKSAUSTRALIA_","")) |>
  left_join(nmdsScores_all, 
            by = c("dep"),
            keep = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

# make summarized df for plotting by cluster & light regime
psd_clust_light <- psd_monthdiel_cluster |>
  group_by(cluster, light_fac, frequency) |>
   summarize(
    min_psd = min(qmed),
    med_psd = median(qmed),
    max_psd = max(qmed)
  )

# make summarized df for plotting by cluster only
psd_clust <- psd_monthdiel_cluster |>
  group_by(cluster, frequency) |>
   summarize(
    min_psd = min(qmed),
    med_psd = median(qmed),
    max_psd = max(qmed)
  )

# plot each median line to think deep thoughts about it
ggplot(data = psd_monthdiel_cluster, 
       aes(x = frequency, 
           y = qmed)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(cluster,dep),
                color = light_fac)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.1, end = 0.8)+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(cluster))+ 
  theme_bw()

# ggsave(paste0("figs/", "PSD_by_clusters_monthdiel_facet.png"), width=8, height=10,
#        units="in", dpi=300)

# plot summary PSDs by cluster & light regime
ggplot(data = psd_clust_light, 
       aes(x = frequency, 
           y = med_psd)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_psd,
                  ymax = max_psd, 
                  group = interaction(cluster,light_fac),
                  fill = light_fac),
              alpha = 0.5)+
  # geom_line(aes(group = cluster,
  #               color = cluster)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.1, end = 0.8)+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(cluster))+ 
  theme_bw()


# plot summary PSDs by cluster
ggplot(data = psd_clust, 
       aes(x = frequency)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_psd,
                  ymax = max_psd,
                  group = cluster,
                  fill = cluster),
              alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_line(aes(y = med_psd,
                group = cluster,
                color = cluster),
            linewidth = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = min_psd,
                group = cluster,
                color = cluster),
              alpha = 0.5,
            linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y = max_psd,
                group = cluster,
                color = cluster),
              alpha = 0.5,
            linewidth = 0.25) +
  labs(x = "Frequency", 
       y = expression(paste("dB re 1", mu, "Pa"^"2", "Hz"^"-1")),
       color = "Cluster",
       fill = "Cluster")+
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.1, end = 0.8)+
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.1, end = 0.8)+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(cluster))+
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 0),
        strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = NA))
```

### PERMANOVA tests

```{r permanova}

# Test assumption that dispersion is similar among groups
#  --> NS result means we can proceed with PERMANOVA
disp_cluster <- betadisper(dissim_dist_all, 
                           group = nmdsScores_all$cluster)

plot(disp_cluster)

anova(disp_cluster)

# Response: Distances
#           Df     Sum Sq    Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
# Groups     4 0.00012096 3.0239e-05  1.1266 0.3542
# Residuals 52 0.00139579 2.6842e-05 

#### PERMANOVA test for whether clusters are significantly different from one another

perma_cluster <- adonis2(dissim_dist_all~as.factor(nmdsScores_all$cluster), data = dissim_dist_all, permutations = 9999)

perma_cluster

# adonis2(formula = dissim_dist_all ~ as.factor(nmdsScores_all$cluster), data = dissim_dist_all, permutations = 9999)
#          Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
# Model     4 0.029566 0.85908 79.252  1e-04 ***
# Residual 52 0.004850 0.14092                  
# Total    56 0.034416 1.00000                  
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1

```
